recognize_zh: Kappa 輕鏈原位雜交中，大量藍黑色陽性漿細胞呈帶狀、群聚分布，與 lambda 染色對照後比值仍屬多株性，排除輕鏈限制性的漿細胞腫瘤或 MALT 淋巴瘤。
features: In situ hybridization for kappa light chain mRNA (blue chromogen), low power
Numerous positive plasma cells in bands, clusters, and scattered single cells
Density moderately greater than lambda-positive cells on the paired stain
Adipose tissue at right edge and fibrous stroma are negative
describe_en: In situ hybridization for kappa light chain highlights numerous plasma cells arranged in bands, clusters, and scattered single cells throughout a fibrotic stroma, with adjacent adipose tissue at the edge. Kappa-positive cells are moderately more numerous than lambda-positive cells on the paired stain, a ratio within the polytypic range and not indicative of light-chain restriction. Findings support a reactive polytypic plasma cell infiltrate, consistent with the plasmacytic component of extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma shows light-chain restricted plasma cells (kappa:lambda markedly skewed) with a CD20+ B-cell infiltrate, unlike the polytypic plasma cells of RDD.
Plasmacytoma consists of sheets of monotypic plasma cells, without the S100+ emperipolesis-rich histiocytes of RDD.
IgG4-RD also has polytypic plasma cells but shows storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis, and lacks large S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.
